Qhov twg cov kev cai yuav tsum tau siv, lawv yuav tsum muaj feem ntau dua li Tshooj no.

6.5. Rau cov Neeg Siv uas tsis yog cov neeg siv khoom (cov neeg siv lag luam), txhua tus nqi yog kawg thiab tsis them rov qab rau qhov siab tshaj plaws uas txoj cai lij choj tso cai.

sections.h: 8. Kev Siv Tau Txais

sections.h: 9. AI Yam Ntxwv, Synthetic Content thiab Kev Tshaj Tawm

Rau cov neeg siv lag luam, kev sib cav sib ceg raug tswj los ntawm kev txiav txim siab tshwj xeeb ntawm lub tsev hais plaub uas muaj peev xwm rau Tus Neeg Muab Kev Pab Cuam lub chaw ua haujlwm sau npe (Warsaw, Poland). sections.h: 1. Ncuav Qab Zib thiab Cov Txheej Txheem Zoo Sib Xws Yog Dab Tsi
sections.b:
1.1. Ncuav qab zib yog cov ntaub ntawv me me uas khaws cia rau hauv koj lub cuab yeej thaum koj mus saib lub vev xaib, tso cai rau lub vev xaib paub koj lub cuab yeej thiab nco qab cov kev nyiam.

1.2. Ntxiv rau ncuav qab zib, TrendTraffic platform siv lub browser Local Storage — ntawm lwm yam, los khaws koj qhov kev tso cai token ntawm koj qhov kev sib tham, koj hom lus thiab interface theme, thiab koj qhov kev xaiv ncuav qab zib. Txoj Cai no siv rau ncuav qab zib thiab Local Storage ib yam nkaus.

sections.h: 2. Cov Txheej Txheem Peb Siv
sections.b:
2.1. Yuav tsum tau ua (kev siv tshuab) — yuav tsum tau ua rau Platform ua haujlwm; lawv raug siv raws li Tus Neeg Muab Kev Pab Cuam qhov kev txaus siab raug cai thiab tsis tas yuav tsum tau pom zoo:

  • vibevox_token — JWT kev tso cai token ntawm koj qhov kev sib tham (Local Storage; kom txog thaum tawm los yog token tas sij hawm);
  • vibevox_user — ib qho cache ntawm tus neeg siv profile uas tau nkag mus (Local Storage; kom txog thaum tawm);
  • tt_cookie_consent — khaws koj qhov kev xaiv ncuav qab zib (Local Storage; kom txog thaum koj hloov lossis tshem tawm).

2.2. Kev ua haujlwm (kev nyiam):

  • i18nextLng — hom lus xaiv (Local Storage; kom txog thaum hloov lossis tshem tawm);
  • vibevox_theme — lub teeb / tsaus theme (Local Storage; kom txog thaum hloov lossis tshem tawm).

Vim yog keeb kwm, qee cov cim qhia muaj "vibevox" prefix ntawm Tus Neeg Muab Kev Pab Cuam cov khoom qub; lawv yog cov khoom ntawm TrendTraffic platform.

2.3. Kev tshuaj ntsuam: Platform tam sim no tsis teeb tsis muaj tus neeg thib peb kev tshuaj ntsuam lossis kev tshaj tawm trackers. Cov kev ntsuas kev pabcuam yooj yim, tiv thaiv kev ceev ntiag tug raug sau los ntawm server-side yam tsis muaj kev taug qab hla lub vev xaib. Yog tias kev tshuaj ntsuam raws li kev pom zoo raug qhia, lawv yuav khiav tsuas yog tom qab koj xaiv "Txais tag nrho".

2.4. Cov ncuav qab zib thib peb: cov kev pabcuam sab nraud uas tau koom ua ke rau hauv Platform tuaj yeem teeb tsa lawv tus kheej cov ncuav qab zib thaum koj siv lawv:

  • Stripe — kev ruaj ntseg them nyiaj thiab kev tiv thaiv kev dag ntxias ntawm kev them nyiaj thiab cov nplooj ntawv them nqi (piv txwv li __stripe_mid, ~1 xyoos; __stripe_sid, ~30 feeb);
  • Google — thaum koj siv "Sign in with Google", Google teeb ncuav qab zib raws li nws tus kheej txoj cai;

sections.h: 3. Lub Hom Phiaj Siv

sections.h: 4. Kev Pom Zoo thiab Kev Tswj Hwm Kev Nyiam

4.1. Thaum koj tuaj saib thawj zaug, Platform qhia ib daim ntawv qhia kev pom zoo raws li Tshooj 399 ntawm Polish Electronic Communications Law (Prawo komunikacji elektronicznej), GDPR thiab ePrivacy Directive (2002/58/EC). Koj tuaj yeem xaiv "Txais tag nrho" lossis "Tsuas yog qhov tsim nyog" — ob qho kev xaiv yog sib npaug, thiab tsis muaj cov txheej txheem tsis tseem ceeb raug qhib ua ntej koj xaiv.

4.2. Koj tuaj yeem hloov koj qhov kev xaiv txhua lub sijhawm — siv "Cookie settings" txuas hauv qab ntawm lub vev xaib lossis lub pob hauv qab Txoj Cai no; daim ntawv qhia yuav rov qhib dua.

4.3. Feem ntau cov browsers kuj tso cai rau koj thaiv lossis tshem tawm ncuav qab zib thiab Local Storage hauv lawv cov chaw (Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, Safari, Microsoft Edge). Nco ntsoov: yog tias cov ntaub ntawv tsim nyog raug thaiv lossis tshem tawm tag nrho, kev nkag mus thiab siv Platform yuav ua tsis tau.
